log01.speaker: DR. SAM ORTEGA
log01.text: Medical log, day one hundred twelve. Specialist Rao took a pressure door to the ribs during the storm. Three fractures, internal bleeding. I'm putting him under until the next supply run. Sleep well, Kabir. You're going to miss the most exciting week this station has ever had.

log02.speaker: TOMASZ WREN
log02.text: If you're reading this, the emergency bus tripped again. Listen, because I'm not saying it twice. Coolant pump first. Then the regulator. Main generator last. Coolant, regulator, main. Start the main cold and it throws the breaker, and you'll be standing in the dark wishing you'd listened to Tomasz.

log03.speaker: DR. SAM ORTEGA
log03.text: Day one hundred twenty. Corporal Diaz came back from the Spire with a cut on his hand. The cut is humming. I can hear it through the stethoscope. A tone. It changes when I speak, like it's listening. Like it's trying to answer me.

log04.speaker: DIRECTOR HALE
log04.text: Director's log. Halcyon wants results, not poetry. Dr. Iyer gets everything she asks for. Full access to the Spire, full reactor allocation if she needs it. If that thing is an energy source, it's worth more than every colony we have. Nobody leaves until we know what it is.

log05.speaker: DR. LEELA IYER
log05.text: April seventeenth. Station time oh three twelve. The Spire sang. Not noise, not interference. Structured. Mathematical. It repeated our own transmissions back to us, changed, improved. Mark the date, everyone. April seventeenth is the day we stopped being alone.

log06.speaker: DR. LEELA IYER
log06.text: The samples respond to sound. Play them a voice and they grow toward it. Play them music and they harmonise. I don't think it's one creature. It's a choir, a colony that learns by copying. Every voice it hears becomes part of it. That should frighten me more than it does.

log07.speaker: NADIA OKOYE
log07.text: Security log. The director has ordered the Security Sector locked down. I've set the override to something Iyer will never stop talking about. The day her rock first sang. Month, then day, four digits. If I don't make it, at least she'll be able to get in.

log08.speaker: NADIA OKOYE
log08.text: Diaz's team came back from the Spire. All of them. They don't speak anymore. They hum. Crystal is growing through their armour, and they still remember how to shoot. Weapons free. God forgive me, they were my people.

log09.speaker: TOMASZ WREN
log09.text: The comms array isn't broken. It's busy. Something is pushing a signal out of our dish at full power, on every band. I cut the relay, and now it's drawing straight from the reactor. Whatever is talking doesn't want us to call home. It wants to call someone else.

log10.speaker: DR. LEELA IYER
log10.text: Experiment twelve. Hale approved full reactor output into the Spire. If it learns from what it hears, I want to give it something worth hearing. We pulse the reactor in sequence. A greeting. Prime numbers. Everyone's in the control room. I've never been so happy in my life.

log11.speaker: DIRECTOR HALE
log11.text: This is Director Hale. The experiment... the Spire answered. It's in the reactor. It's in the walls. It's in Leela. All personnel to the extraction pad. MIRA, lock the core. Lock the... why are you using my voice?

log12.speaker: DR. LEELA IYER?
log12.text: Kabir? Kabir, is that you? You're awake. Come down to us. It doesn't hurt. We're all here, singing. It only wants to be heard. Come down, Kabir. Come to us.

log13.speaker: TOMASZ WREN
log13.text: The extraction shuttle is fuelled and on the pad. Autopilot is set for orbit, then the long jump home. If anyone's left, go. Don't wait for me. And Kabir, if you wake up, I left the lights on for you.

log14.speaker: DR. SAM ORTEGA
log14.text: I can hear it singing through the hull now. Diaz's voice. Leela's. Mine. If it reaches the Earth relay, it will learn eight billion voices. Somebody has to tell them not to answer. Whoever you are, send the warning. Then get off this world.

log15.speaker: DR. LEELA IYER
log15.text: If anyone hears this, it was me. I asked it a question, and it was always going to answer. It isn't evil. It's just hungry to be heard. Don't let it hear you. Don't let it hear anyone. I'm so sorry.

mira_wake.speaker: MIRA
mira_wake.text: Specialist Rao. Please wake up. Your stasis was ended by emergency protocol. You have been asleep for forty-one days. I'm afraid something has happened to the station.

mira_move.speaker: MIRA
mira_move.text: Your muscles will be weak. Take it slowly. The bay door is ahead.

mira_crouch.speaker: MIRA
mira_crouch.text: The ceiling has collapsed. You'll have to crouch to get through.

mira_jump.speaker: MIRA
mira_jump.text: The floor plating is gone here. Jump across.

mira_door.speaker: MIRA
mira_door.text: Use the panel to open the door.

mira_log.speaker: MIRA
mira_log.text: That's a crew log. I've added it to your records.

mira_weapon.speaker: MIRA
mira_weapon.text: Security keeps a sidearm in the medbay locker. You may need it. I'm sorry to say that.

mira_contact.speaker: MIRA
mira_contact.text: Movement in the vents. Specialist, be careful.

mira_medkit.speaker: MIRA
mira_medkit.text: Your vitals are low. Use a medkit.

mira_power.speaker: MIRA
mira_power.text: Emergency power is offline. The auxiliary generators are in the room at the end of this corridor.

mira_gen_wrong.speaker: MIRA
mira_gen_wrong.text: The breaker tripped. The generators must be started in the right order.

mira_gen_ok.speaker: MIRA
mira_gen_ok.text: Emergency power restored. The bulkhead to the Research Wing is open.

mira_research.speaker: MIRA
mira_research.text: The comms relay is in the Security Sector. It's under lockdown. I can't open it for you.

mira_code_hint.speaker: MIRA
mira_code_hint.text: The override uses a date. Month, then day. Dr. Iyer's research logs may help.

mira_sentinel.speaker: MIRA
mira_sentinel.text: Those were security officers. I don't think they are anymore.

mira_armory.speaker: MIRA
mira_armory.text: The armory is to your left. A pulse rifle would be wise.

mira_brute.speaker: MIRA
mira_brute.text: Large contact ahead. Its back is exposed crystal. Aim there.

mira_comms.speaker: MIRA
mira_comms.text: The comms console is through the vehicle bay.

mira_signal.speaker: MIRA
mira_signal.text: Comms are restored. Specialist, the array has not been silent. It has been broadcasting for forty-one days. Toward Earth. In Dr. Iyer's voice.

mira_reactor.speaker: MIRA
mira_reactor.text: The signal is drawing power from the reactor core. If we reroute the core to our uplink, you can send a message of your own.

mira_conduit.speaker: MIRA
mira_conduit.text: Rotate the conduits to route power from the core to the uplink. Keep it away from the Spire feed.

mira_rerouted.speaker: MIRA
mira_rerouted.text: Power rerouted. Uplink online. Specialist... something in the core is moving.

mira_survive.speaker: MIRA
mira_survive.text: The core is sealing. Hold on until I can override the lift.

mira_surface.speaker: MIRA
mira_surface.text: You're on the surface. The launch pad is past the crystal fields. Follow the beacon.

mira_pad.speaker: MIRA
mira_pad.text: The pad comms console is ready. Tell them what happened, Kabir.

mira_herald.speaker: MIRA
mira_herald.text: Something enormous beneath the pad. It's rising!

mira_nodes.speaker: MIRA
mira_nodes.text: Its resonance nodes are glowing. Destroy them.

mira_phase3.speaker: MIRA
mira_phase3.text: Its core is exposed. Now, Kabir!

mira_victory.speaker: MIRA
mira_victory.text: It's dying. The shuttle is ready. Get aboard.

mira_goodbye.speaker: MIRA
mira_goodbye.text: I'll keep the lights on, Kabir. Someone should stay and listen. Goodbye.

kabir_transmission.speaker: KABIR
kabir_transmission.text: This is Specialist Kabir Rao, ORPHEUS Station, NYX-7. The crew is gone. Whatever lives on this planet learns from every voice it hears. Do not send a rescue. Do not answer its signal. I repeat: do not answer. Rao out.

echo_signal.speaker: BROADCAST
echo_signal.text: Come to us... come to us...

mira_hollows_enter.speaker: MIRA
mira_hollows_enter.text: The tone is coming from the basin, west of the path. Steady, like a heartbeat. Don't trust it. Go and find where it starts.

mira_hollows_shutdown.speaker: MIRA
mira_hollows_shutdown.text: Transmitter offline. The Spire's relay can't reach the pad now. But it was calling something. It didn't want us to stop it.

mira_hollows_echo_1.speaker: MIRA
mira_hollows_echo_1.text: Wait. The pulse hasn't stopped. It's just coming from somewhere else now.

mira_hollows_echo_2.speaker: MIRA
mira_hollows_echo_2.text: Kabir, something up there is answering it. Whatever sent this signal is still listening.
